posts.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
posts.title_th: Anthropic เปิดตัว Claude Opus 5 — ก้าวกระโดดสำหรับ AI agent รุ่นถัดไป
posts.content: Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, positioning it as a step-change improvement for the Opus tier designed specifically for powering long-running AI agents. The model delivers improvements in coding and professional work, with Anthropic claiming near-parity with Fable 5 on complex reasoning tasks. Pricing is set at $5 input / $25 output per million tokens, equal to Opus 4.8 but approximately half the cost of Fable 5. Notable: HackerNews reported elevated errors on Claude Opus 5 on July 28, indicating rapid adoption stress-testing the infrastructure.

posts.title: Our position on open-weights models
posts.title_th: Anthropic แถลงจุดยืนต่อ open-weights AI models เป็นครั้งแรก
posts.content: Anthropic released a formal position statement on open-weights models on July 27, 2026. This marks the first time the company has publicly articulated its stance on open-source AI in a formal document, coming just days after Moonshot AI released Kimi K3 as an open-weight model on HuggingFace. The timing suggests the statement is partly a response to accelerating open-weight model releases from Chinese AI labs.

posts.title: Kimi K3 Releases on HuggingFace — 2.8T parameter open-weight model from Moonshot AI
posts.title_th: Kimi K3 ปล่อยบน HuggingFace แล้ว โมเดล 2.8 ล้านล้านพารามิเตอร์จาก Moonshot AI
posts.content: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3 on HuggingFace as an open-weight model with 2.8 trillion parameters, positioned to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic's frontier models. The release attracted immediate massive attention on Hacker News, becoming the second most popular story with 527 points and 241 comments. The model is released under the Kimi K3 License, which restricts commercial service providers above certain thresholds from using it without separate agreements. Techsauce Thailand covered it as challenging OpenAI, Anthropic, and Alibaba simultaneously.
posts.tech_impact: Kimi K3 is the most significant open-weight model release since Llama 4, with 2.8T parameters potentially offering frontier-class capability. Its license structure will be a key adoption determinant for enterprise.
